title: Returned Payments and the 2026-27 Late Payment Fee: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program
content:
**Clause.** Under the board-approved 2026-27 late payment fee schedule of the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, a fixed returned-payment addition is added to a month's late payment fee. The addition is set by the family payments on the enrollment that the bank returned within a 12-month window. A return counts when it posted after the same day of the month 12 months before the day the fee posts, and on or before the day the fee posts. When that earlier month has no such day, the last day of that month is used. The addition is:

- **two or more returned:** 10.00;
- **exactly one returned:** 5.00;
- **none returned:** nothing.

Returned payments are read as the returned-payment entries on the enrollment's own billing history.

## Window boundaries (hypothetical fee posting date of March 18)

| Returned payment posted | Counted? |
|---|---|
| March 18 of the previous year, the same day 12 months before | no, the window starts after that day |
| March 19 of the previous year | yes |
| January of this year | yes |
| March 18, the day the fee posts | yes, the window ends on that day |

For a fee posting on February 29 of a leap year, the previous year's February has no 29th. The window then starts after February 28 of the previous year: a return posted on that February 28 is not counted, and one posted on March 1 is.

## Worked cases

| Returned payments on the enrollment within the window | Addition |
|---|---|
| 0 | nothing |
| 1 | 5.00 |
| 3 | 10.00 |

A returned payment on a sibling's enrollment is not a payment on this enrollment and does not count here.
